articles.title: ChatGPT developer OpenAI said to discuss offering U.S. government a 5% stake: FT
articles.snippet: The proposal aims to give the American public a financial stake in AI while easing political scrutiny of the industry.

articles.title: Metaplanet buys another $170 million of bitcoin expanding treasury to 43,000 BTC
articles.snippet: The Japanese firm, now the world's third largest publicly traded bitcoin holder, reported stronger Bitcoin Income Generation revenue.

articles.title: Robinhood rolls out public blockchain as it expands deeper into crypto
articles.snippet: Robinhood's product push continues to blur the line between crypto and more traditional finance.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation lays out use cases for governments, institutions in new policy guide
articles.snippet: The Ethereum Foundation said policymakers should distinguish between decentralized public blockchains and networks that remain controlled by corporations or foundations, arguing that governance structures will play a critical role in determining which platforms are suitable for long-term public sector use.

articles.title: UK payments blueprint outlines tokenized payments for ‘multi-money ecosystem’
articles.snippet: UK regulators published an update to a national retail payments blueprint, calling for infrastructure support for tokenization and interoperability with new forms of digital money.
